prs.body:
The earlier comparison allowed output-domain differences to interact with a fixed random head. This stage adds GRU, official CfC, PLIF, event-time-gradient LIF, official S4D, SDPA attention, and HCSN core wrappers behind the same frozen frontend and output head. An optional identity-initialized learnable output adapter is applied identically to every core and charged to its parameter and compute budget.

CfC's default convex combination of two tanh outputs is bounded, like GRU. The event LIF wrapper retains an explicit event-time gradient path; it is a small baseline, not a reproduction of every EventProp training system.

This is the first of five stacked P2 implementation stages. The completed stack passes 10 local behavior tests with pinned official dependencies and an archived exact source capsule. This PR does not claim adequate training, a quality ranking, or a scientific benefit.

prs.display_title: hcsn: add common-frontend temporal core comparison adapters

prs.body:
Grid-dependent kernel construction and memory use need to be counted before a fair training comparison. This stage adds a per-fit cold cache keyed by exact time-gap bits and complete frozen operator identity, weighted microbatch accumulation, and a bounded cost probe that saves source, configuration, checkpoints, and process receipts.

The cache rejects learnable physical parameters and clears on state reload. Microbatches retain the whole effective-batch weighted-loss denominator and sequence padding, then clip and step once. The completed stack tests exact cached/uncached values and gradients, one-ULP gap separation, and full-batch versus accumulated loss, gradients, and Adam updates.

This is the second of five stacked P2 stages. Numeric qualification and speed measurements remain scoped to their exact configurations; no training-domain or scientific-benefit claim is made here.

prs.head: codex/hcsn-p2-cost-20261110-c385
prs.display_title: hcsn: measure frozen-kernel cost and preserve microbatch gradients

prs.body:
A completed optimizer loop is insufficient evidence of an adequately trained comparison. This stage records full ABC training visits, an independent training-only memorization diagnostic, per-epoch development metrics, strict best-checkpoint selection, separate plateau stopping, time-to-quality, checkpoints, logits, source hashes, and failed-attempt costs.

The common frontend and output head remain frozen and identical across arms for each seed. Diagnostic fitting resets before the main fit. The weighted effective batch is preserved during microbatch accumulation, and test subject E is not used to select the configuration.

This is the third of five stacked P2 stages. The completed stack passes 10 local behavior tests; archived historical attempts keep their original source and checkpoint rule. Training adequacy, numerical qualification, overall repository CI, and scientific benefit are separate gates.

prs.head: codex/hcsn-p2-trainer-20261110-c385
prs.display_title: hcsn: archive auditable temporal-core training attempts

prs.body:
Fair comparisons must retain tuning opportunities, retries, resource limits, and unsuccessful fits. This stage adds a bounded campaign driver that records its plan before launching attempts, enforces worker and fit limits, keeps per-attempt process journals, and summarizes quality, training adequacy, time-to-quality, and measured costs without treating missing energy measurements as zero.

It selects only from declared seeds and learning rates and keeps source-before/source-after hashes. Equal-resource quality and resources-to-quality are explicit report fields; a timeout or failed fit remains in the ledger.

This is the fourth of five stacked P2 stages. Local behavior validation is on the completed stack. A campaign result is not a scientific ranking until the training and numerical gates are satisfied.

prs.body:
This final P2 implementation stage checks the mechanics that could silently invalidate a common-frontend comparison: shared frozen tensors, identity output adapters, active event gradients, exact frozen-table reuse and invalidation, one-ULP time-gap separation, and weighted microbatch loss/gradient/Adam equivalence.

Validation: 10/10 tests passed in 3.217 seconds on the pinned cloud CPU environment with official ncps, SpikingJelly, and the recorded S4 checkout. The exact tested source capsule and receipt are being added in the evidence follow-up. The independent immutable v6 run also passed 10/10; the canonical copy differs only by formatting/import cleanup as recorded by AST equivalence.

This completes the five stacked implementation stages. It does not turn local tests into overall CI, training adequacy, or demonstrated scientific benefit.
